_what: Every element list in the system, and where it lives. machine/elements.py build reads each one where it is and writes the library in one shape; it never edits a source. A list is changed at its source, then machine/elements.py build runs.
_rule: the owner, 2026-09-20: every element defined once, every row the same fields, every one enforced — a value that is not on a list is refused, not guessed.

sources.enforced_by: the AI video machine's preflight; the second door (compose.py)

inline.name: Tip stack
inline.what: The cover names the count ('4 tips…'), then one tip per slide, numbered; the last slide is the ask or the product.
inline.why_it_works: A number on the cover is a promise of how long it takes; each swipe pays one tip, so the whole thing gets read.
inline.examples: An Instagram creator's '4 tips to master animated ads' carousel (saved 2026-09-22); organic TikTok photo posts tagged #glowup #skincare (intake 2026-09-20, kind carousel)

inline.name: Text-card thread
inline.what: Plain text cards, one thought per slide, no photography — the slides read as a thread; the account's name is the only picture.
inline.why_it_works: Reads as someone thinking out loud, not as an ad; the swipe is the page turn.
inline.examples: An Instagram motivation-mindset account's text-card carousel (saved 2026-09-22)

inline.name: Step tutorial
inline.what: A how-to: the result on the cover, one step per slide with the screen or the hands shown, and a 'comment X for the file' close.
inline.why_it_works: Every slide is proof the result is reachable; the comment gate turns readers into a list.
inline.examples: An Instagram creator's 'Comment CLAYMATION for the skill' carousel (saved 2026-09-22)

inline.name: Before/after swipe
inline.what: Slide one is the before; the swipe reveals the after; the slides that follow are the routine that got there.
inline.why_it_works: The reader performs the reveal herself, which is the strongest way to show change without a claim in words.
inline.examples: Organic TikTok photo posts tagged #jawline #debloat #glowup (intake 2026-09-20 — 4 carousels routed to image-teardown, sequence form)

inline.name: Caption joke series
inline.what: The same joke set-up carried across slides — one captioned photo per slide, the punchline on the last.
inline.why_it_works: Comedy relatability that gets shared; the last slide is where the account or the product sits.
inline.examples: An Instagram comedy-relatable account's 'How to say … in Chinese?' carousel (saved 2026-09-22)

inline.name: Product slide set
inline.what: One product, ingredient or benefit per slide, each with one hard label; the cover is the claim, the last slide the offer. The paid-carousel default.
inline.why_it_works: Lets one ad carry six objections without a feature list; Meta shows the slide that earns the tap.
inline.examples: none on file yet — intake routes every paid `media: carousel` ad here; the first one swiped fills this row
